meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 将纯文本或 Markdown 文件整理成规范格式：补全 frontmatter（标题、slug、摘要），用标题、粗体、列表等重排内容，保存为“原文件名-formatted.md”，并自动修复引号、中英文间距等排版问题。
howto.when: 当你提出“格式化 Markdown”“美化文章”等要求，或想改善文章排版时触发；若文件已是 Markdown，会先让你选择优化方式。

say.text: 把我的纯文本笔记整理成带标题和摘要的 Markdown 文件
优化这个 Markdown 的标题层级和列表，并修复引号
say.note: 运行脚本并输出新文件

say.text: 只修复排版，不要改变原文结构

howto.what_en: Formats plain text or Markdown into a well-structured file: adds frontmatter (title, slug, summary), reorganizes content with headings, bold, lists, etc., saves as {filename}-formatted.md, and auto-fixes quotes, CJK/English spacing, and emphasis punctuation.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to “format Markdown”, “beautify article”, or improve article layout. If the file is already Markdown, it asks you to choose optimize, keep original, or typography-only.

say_en.text: Turn my plain-text notes into a Markdown file with title and summary
Improve the heading hierarchy and lists in this Markdown, then fix quotes
say_en.note: Runs the script and outputs a new file

say_en.text: Only fix typography, keep the original structure as-is
